findings.fact: ESS sample is XML aggregate of work board, architecture and design; standalone .sgendesign is JSON DesignDoc. XML design format eluslot.esui is not JSON sgenaxis.design.
findings.required: Separate DocumentFormat EssXmlV1 vs DesignJsonV1 with exact version detection and mapping; reject mismatched format, no extension-only detection or JSON-in-XML assumption.

findings.fact: All XML attribute values begin as text: architecture x/y, design props, booleans, IDs and empty parentId. A generic number/bool conversion can change semantics or spelling.
findings.required: Explicit per-field typed interpretation and absent/empty/false/0 rules; preserve unknown fields or reject before partial state. Define stable node IDs and no cross-section remap.

findings.fact: C1 JSON preservation policy does not define XML guides, namespaces/comments/text whitespace or work/architecture canonical semantics. scene_doc.rs primarily checks relative path/extensions and delegates text save/load.
findings.required: Choose lossless XML tree representation vs exact closed typed schema before assigning semantic digest; clarify comments/whitespace/attribute order versus business content. No digest based on raw bytes called semantic.

findings.fact: ESS single-document capture includes work+architecture+design. Treating only design subtree as captured state can drop adjacent content on save.
findings.required: S2 codec input/output covers entire aggregate; section ownership stays declared, no serialize-only-current-tab operation. Use explicit unchanged-subtree oracle.

options.proposal: Recommended planning direction: explicit format-specific lossless model plus validated typed business projections; retain full recognized aggregate content, reject unsupported unknown schema features before candidate installation. Exact allowlist/schema and canonical rules still need one precise packet.
Closed typed schema for complete ESS root/work/architecture/design, rejecting all unknown members up front. Requires exhaustive schema/fixtures, not just current sample. No silent drop/defaults.
